verses.1: The songs of joy, when Jehovah returns to take back Zion, are like shofars.
verses.2: Then, the voids will be filled, and our desires will be satisfied. Then, people will say, “In these nations, Jehovah has increased His actions towards them.”
verses.3: The LORD increased His kindness toward us, and we were filled with joy.
verses.4: May the LORD bring us back, like birds flying over the mountains.
verses.5: The seeds will be planted in fertile soil.
verses.6: Let him go away! Let him leave, and take along with him the seeds of his planting. When the time comes, let him carry them away with him.
